'''Zoalin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] who served in the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Defense Fleet]] aboard the ''[[Adamantine]]''. In [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], he was aboard the ship when it traveled to [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]] as part of a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] task force. However, the ship was infected with the [[Death Seed]] plague and members of the crew started to die, something that greatly confused Zoalin. However, he too eventually succumbed to the plague and died.
